primary_source_policy: Actual core introduction + teacher Wordlists + correct approved activity/key language. Preserve game content and unique resources. Separate core target, practice-only scaffold and incidental example.

First4 are core exact models; last4 support approved game. A digital hour/minute spelling key should cover ten/twenty/thirty/forty/fifty; avoid using deliberately wrong game captions as reference.
Actual Rivera input adds husband/wife/children beyond current game. Parents supported by2C possessive model; relation chart must identify roles, not stereotypes.
All10; white has visible outline, US gray; use color+label cues.

All7 spelled correctly. Weekday/weekend source context; avoid claiming every learner has the same workweek.

Use known/supported food meanings: chips/salt,ice cream/sugar,lemon,chili pepper. Useful core context vegan,plants,meat,burger,chips,ice cream,strawberry,lemon,chili pepper,fries,menu; tasty is title support. Do not infer every version of a food has one flavor.
All4 verbs with their objects; bowl is a practice-only scaffold. Sequence must wash→cut→add→mix in existing recipe game.
Free=$0/no money; share=food for you/me; waste=usable food not eaten/shared. No safety claims or compulsory real sharing.
All10: new picture shows6, missing-item clues retrieve4. Jeans/shoes plural, other nouns take a/an when singular.
Meaningful chunks pay by card,try on a jacket,keep an item,return an item. Return-item meaning differs from8D return-ticket.
Only these4at5C; do not pre-teach6A full town set. Places↔visible stock/purpose cues support mission.
Person/place/payment/document distinctions. Useful chunks Do you have any…? I’d like some…,please;Anything else?No,thanks;How much is it?Can I pay by card?Here’s your receipt;Can I get a receipt?
All6places and functional chunks. Letter-envelope meaning differs from alphabet letter.
Mall=shopping center; closed=not open. No actual venue hours/safety rules claimed.

4rooms+4furniture. Useful source gloss tiny=very small;free time=available leisure, distinct from free=$0. Optional lamp/armchair only if clearly labeled as practice picture extras, not required core.
Arrows distinguish along/across/through/past. On foot=walking. Crossroads is a grammar-bank scaffold; opposite belongs to explicitly labeled practical extension, not retroactive6B target.
All12calendar order and accurate spelling.

Exact core models. Reference must support all calendar dates1–31 using a complete list or a clear pattern; ensure fifth/eighth/ninth/twelfth/twentieth/thirtieth and compound endings. July twelfth / the twelfth of July.
Visible fictional today/year anchor; ago=before now after duration. Last night and yesterday are not identical periods.
Correct labels, not intentionally wrong game labels. Simple fresh visual/meaning cues; no new music-style taxonomy.
All7pairs and useful chunks; approved repair story retrieves every form. Base after did/didn’t remains a grammar-bank pattern.
Ordered event-arrow cue; existing open retelling preserved. Do not turn an exact printed ordered list into a claimed memory challenge without covering it.

strongest_completeness_risks: V1alphabet must be allA–Z, not just password letters;0–10 not just code examples; alljobs and bothwaiter/waitress.
V2family husband/wife/children are actual core input despite missing from old game; headphone missing-object cue still needs complete8-item reference.
V3daily routines must include3D fiveadditional uniquechunks, not only3A eight.
V4support nouns in recipes/flavor cues and object models need modest source scaffolding.
V7allmonths, supported1–31ordinalspellings and all7irregularpairs required; reference must use correct forms, not deliberate game errors.
V8all5animals, including unrecorded goose/beaver; all6bodyparts and4complaints with articles; opaque nouns need genuine meaning cues.
avoid_future_dump: Early adjective destinationV1 contains1B/1C plus2Dreinforcement only; quiet/noisy and3Cplace input stayV3.5Cfourplaces remain separate from6Asixplaces.
intentional_exclusions: Incidental proper names/cities/celebrities are not new spelling lists. Mexico in a capital-letter model does not justify Mexican nationality.
Function words and every classroom instruction verb do not become a second vocabulary syllabus.
Incidental visible apartment furniture extras are optional unless explicitly labeled/input; no need to assess every object in a photograph.
No stock/core image recycling or change to approved private/memory game mechanics.
